gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, priced on 2026-11-26, the UGREEN Nexode 20,000 mAh 130W ($54.99 at us.ugreen.com) costs less than every other 20,000 mAh bank with a 100 W port that was read (Baseus FC41 20K 100W $59.99, Cuktech 15 Ultra $67.14, UGREEN's 100 W-only 20K $79.99), nor that ChatGPT's second pick, the Anker 20K 87W, gives 65 W at most from one port (under Apple's 70 W fast-charge adapter for the Air) and showed Sold Out on anker.com that day.
standout_why: Compared against the Macworld review (cited), the best-batteries.com review, and the UGREEN store data behind the cited product page. Macworld covers only the UGREEN, prices it at $99.99 and compares it only with UGREEN's 12K and 25K sizes. best-batteries.com has an alternatives table, but it prices the 130W at a $89.99 catalog price, shows no price for the Anker 87W, and lists neither Baseus nor Cuktech. The UGREEN store data gives its own price and specs only. None of them puts the 20K/100 W class side by side at today's prices, and none says the Anker stops at 65 W per port or is sold out at Anker's US store. The cited Costco page returned HTTP 429 and was not read.
decides: It confirms ChatGPT's pick: the UGREEN Nexode 20K 130W is the lowest-priced bank read today that meets the page's line (20,000 mAh, one 100 W USB-C port), and it is linkable through cj:ugreen (no record yet, variant 41192314372158). It changes the runner-up: the Anker 20K 87W falls below the line at 65 W per port and was sold out at anker.com, so it belongs in the left-out list. The Cuktech 15 Ultra is the row for a 140 W PD 3.1 port, at $12.15 more and 114 g heavier than the UGREEN. Our existing record (the UGREEN 100W 20K bundle) meets the line, but its bank costs $79.99 alone against $54.99 for the 130W, so it does not beat the 130W unless its $60.22 bundle price still holds; that price was last read 2026-11-11 and not re-read today.
